title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border payments to reduce settlement risk

title: Bitcoin slips after rebounding from July 14 low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations

title: Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End
content: Bitcoin Magazine Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong will introduce a bill by year-end to license crypto dealers, advisers, managers and custodians, after only two of 36 first-round stablecoin applicants received licenses in April. title: Sweden’s H100 Taps Coinbase Prime and Deribit for Its 3,506 Bitcoin Treasury as It Courts Family Offices
content: Bitcoin Magazine Sweden’s H100 Taps Coinbase Prime and Deribit for Its 3,506 Bitcoin Treasury as It Courts Family Offices H100 Group will use Coinbase Prime and Deribit for custody, trading and financing of its roughly 3,506 BTC, worth about $226 million, as it builds bitcoin services for family offices and wealthy investors. title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $64,000 After Weekend Plunge to $62,000
